name: Photoreal camera and HDRI lighting
what: Makes a three.js scene read as a photograph. One real sky (HDRI) lights everything: the sun is found in the image and becomes a shadow-casting light with contact-hardening soft shadows (PCSS), and a probe captured in the level adds bounce light and parallax-correct reflections. Then a camera chain: N8AO ambient occlusion, puddle reflections, aerial perspective and sun glow, motion blur, adaptive auto exposure, physical depth of field, bloom, ACES, and lens and film (aberration, distortion, vignetting, grade, grain). Quality presets and dynamic resolution.
use_when: the game should look like real photos or film footage rather than a stylised render, especially first-person or camera games built from real scanned (Poly Haven) assets under an open sky

third_party.what: postprocessing (effect composer, bloom, depth of field, SMAA, tone mapping), npm dependency
third_party.author: Raoul van Rüschen (pmndrs)

third_party.what: n8ao (ambient occlusion), npm dependency; package.json says ISC, its LICENSE file is CC0-1.0
third_party.author: N8python

third_party.what: Hash without Sine (hash12), the film grain hash in effects.js
third_party.author: Dave Hoskins

third_party.what: Demo sky kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_puresky and texture asphalt_04, loaded at runtime from Poly Haven's CDN (not stored)
third_party.author: Poly Haven

good_for: Outdoor or semi-outdoor scenes with scanned CC0 assets that should pass for photos: alleys, yards, streets, ruins, photo or camera games, walking sims, prop hunts. Different times of day are a different HDRI plus a few numbers.
not_for: Stylised, painted, toon, pixel or low-poly looks (it fights them); WebGPU renderers; orthographic cameras; phones and weak laptops as the main target (heavy, frame rate unmeasured there). It draws the frame itself (see HOW-TO-USE.md: a drawWith hook in the starter's renderer).
how_to_add: node tools/blocks/add.mjs meticulai-photoreal, then in my-game: npm install postprocessing@6.39.6 n8ao@2.0.2 (and follow HOW-TO-USE.md 'Drop it into the starter')
